ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  ACME Solar Holdings Limited is undertaking an amalgamation scheme to merge three of its direct and indirect wholly-owned solar power subsidiaries (ACME Pokhran Solar, ACME Sikar Solar, and ACME Eco Clean Energy) into the parent company. This consolidation aims to simplify the corporate structure and streamline operations. A key financial detail is that two of the three merging subsidiaries (ACME Pokhran Solar and ACME Eco Clean Energy) are currently operating at a net loss, which will now be integrated directly into ACME Solar Holdings Limited's financials.
